description: An importlib string and getattr call hide the target from static resolution.

expected_affected.tests/test_price.py::test_price: Directly calls the changed core.price function.
expected_affected.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: The literal runtime module/name pair selects core.price, whose result changes.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.

false_negatives.tests/test_worker.py::test_read: The string-based import and getattr call create no static edge to core.price.

limitations: Runtime imports and reflective calls are not resolved; the dynamic caller test is missed even with a direct positive control.
